git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): address local code review findings F1-F6 on DES-076 round 1

F1 (MCP parity): mission_tools.go's bindDispatchedMission mirrored the
pre-DES-076 CLI wording and emitted nothing on a fresh bind. Now takes
worker, reports the binding unconditionally naming it, and the rebind
message names it too -- matching the CLI exactly.

F2 (stale dedup claim): already resolved incidentally when round 2 wired
BoundVia through dispatchTierB's delegation-skeleton write, replacing the
inline duplicate spawnAgentType was meant to prevent.

F3: a contract-load failure printed `worker ""` with no explanation.
Branches on `ok` now and names the load failure distinctly from an actual
Worker mismatch.

F4: consumeDispatchBinding's failure comment claimed a bounded "one extra
spawn" degradation; a persistent failure (not just a transient one) leaves
the sidecar capturing every matching-worker spawn indefinitely. Corrected.

F5: added the missing dispatch-origin contract-load-failure regression
test (allow, no capture, binding survives) -- the only existing
malformed-sidecar test exercised the opposite (claim-origin, block)
branch. Strengthened the mismatched-worker test to assert
ReadActiveMissionBinding().Origin, not just the mission ID string.

F6 (the load-bearing one): ClearActiveMission removed both sidecar files
unconditionally via errors.Join. A partial failure that removed the
origin file but left active-mission behind converges to a shape
ReadActiveMissionBinding reads as BindOriginClaim -- sticky, ungated by
agent type, stamping commit trailers -- silently resurrecting the
unscoped-capture bug through a different door. Fixed: origin removal is
now attempted only after active-mission removal succeeds. Confirmed
failing pre-fix via TestClearActiveMission_StopsOnActiveMissionRemovalFailure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
